name: Smart Auto Brightness
summary: Gentle ambient-light brightness for Desktop Mode: keeps the brightness you set and adjusts it by at most ±10 % with the room light, ignores short shadows (a hand over the sensor) and ramps softly. Replaces KWin's built-in automatic brightness, which jumps by large amounts within seconds; KWin's setting is restored on uninstall.
restart: Nothing. It starts immediately; your current brightness becomes the baseline.
